conclusion: the accepted Case 1 or valid Case 2 bound satisfies RT(J_i) <= accepted_bound, with the W_i(LO)=0 branch handled only by the direct lemma
exact_statement: For a fixed protected HI task i, let R_i(LO) and W_i(LO) be the LO-mode response and relative-start bounds, and define S_i^1={s in N | 0 <= s < R_i(LO)} and S_i^2={0} when W_i(LO)=0, otherwise S_i^2={s in N | 0 <= s < W_i(LO)}. For s in S_i^1 use the Case 1 integer workload bound; for s in S_i^2 with W_i(LO)>0 use the ordinary Case 2 integer recurrence and accept only its least post-fixed candidate. When W_i(LO)=0, use the direct zero-start lemma and do not invoke the ordinary Case 2 recurrence. Under the protected-window, C-AMC-sem arrival/switch and integer-domain assumptions, the accepted bound upper-bounds RT(J_i).
source_reference: C-AMC-sem framework interface: Case 1 and Case 2 integer workload bounds
